title: In Silicon Valley, AI founders cheer Trump’s calls for the industry to police itself on safety

title: Bodhtree Becomes Datakosa Limited, Targets AI and Cybersecurity Growth in US, Australia
description: Bodhtree Consulting Limited has officially become Datakosa Limited, setting its sights on AI, Cybersecurity and international expansion. With 99% shareholder support, the company is prioritising Australia and the United States.

title: Most say Trump, Congress not taking AI risks seriously
description: WASHINGTON — Most U.S. voters think President Donald Trump's administration and Congress are not taking the risks of AI seriously enough and want the government to write new regulations for the technology, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll.
